description: Write Book 6 of 9: '오멜라스: 잠언 (Omelas: Proverbs)' in Korean. A wisdom/ideas book: through debates, parables, and teaching scenes, the philosophical core is argued out - is becoming a machine truly Nirvana, or annihilation dressed as salvation? Is making robots human the greater good? Features the doubting Engineer and the robot-Good as central voices, moving several characters toward their final choices. Depends on FEAT-001; follows Books 1-5.
steps: Write ~5-6 Korean chapters built around proverbs/parables and philosophical dialogue between factions, dramatized (not dry essays). Center the machine-as-Nirvana vs machine-as-death debate and the robot-to-human counter-doctrine.
Push the doubting Engineer toward a decisive turn that sets up the finale.
acceptance_criteria: books/06-proverbs/ contains 00-index.md and >=5 Korean chapter files.
Dramatizes the central philosophical debate consistent with canon and advances character arcs.
verification: Run: ls books/06-proverbs/ and confirm files exist.
Run: cat books/06-proverbs/chapter-*.md | wc -m and confirm ~11,000-14,000 characters.
Spot-read a chapter for Korean prose and continuity.
